question: Quais cuidados a política exige antes de compartilhar dados com um fornecedor externo?

claims.text: Antes de compartilhar dados com um fornecedor externo, a política exige que o compartilhamento seja feito apenas com um destinatário autorizado e para um propósito comercial aprovado, especialmente para informações classificadas como confidenciais ou restritas.

Deve-se utilizar um mecanismo de transferência segura aprovado ou uma plataforma controlada adequada à classificação da informação, uma vez que o uso apenas do e-mail corporativo não é considerado um meio seguro para dados confidenciais.
Para dados confidenciais do fornecedor, é necessária aprovação da Segurança da Informação e da Governança de IA conforme definido na Matriz de Autoridade de Aprovação.

Se dados do fornecedor ou cliente forem processados por ferramentas de IA, a ferramenta deve estar aprovada para o uso pretendido e conforme a política de compartilhamento de dados e políticas de segurança da informação aplicáveis.

Qualquer exceção ao compartilhamento externo de dados requer justificativa de negócio documentada e aprovações definidas pelos controles de segurança e autoridade correspondentes; uma instrução operacional não pode criar exceção à política corporativa.

      "section_path": [
        "INFORMATION SECURITY POLICY"
      ],
      "page_numbers": [
        1
      ],
      "slide_numbers": [],
      "sheet_names": [],
      "text": "INFORMATION SECURITY POLICY\n\nDocument ID: DOC-006 | Version: 4.0 | Effective: 2026-01-01 | Status: ACTIVE | Domain: Information Security"
    },
    {
      "citation_id": "E38",
      "document_id": "DOC-006",
      "chunk_id": "DOC-006::chunk-00002",
      "source_path": "data/source/corporate_repository/policies/DOC-006_Information_Security_Policy.pdf",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "text-00002",
        "text-00003"
      ],
      "section_path": [
        "1. Purpose"
      ],
      "page_numbers": [
        1
      ],
      "slide_numbers": [],
      "sheet_names": [],
      "text": "1. Purpose\n\nEstablish enterprise-wide requirements for protecting information according to sensitivity, access need, processing environment, and external disclosure risk."
    },
    {
      "citation_id": "E39",
      "document_id": "DOC-006",
      "chunk_id": "DOC-006::chunk-00003",
      "source_path": "data/source/corporate_repository/policies/DOC-006_Information_Security_Policy.pdf",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "text-00004",
        "text-00005"
      ],
      "section_path": [
        "2. Confidential information"
      ],
      "page_numbers": [
        1
      ],
      "slide_numbers": [],
      "sheet_names": [],
      "text": "2. Confidential information\n\nConfidential information includes identifiable customer information, non-public supplier commercial information, credentials and authentication material, non-public contractual terms, sensitive operational data, and other information explicitly classified as confidential by the enterprise."
    },
    {
      "citation_id": "E40",
      "document_id": "DOC-006",
      "chunk_id": "DOC-006::chunk-00005",
      "source_path": "data/source/corporate_repository/policies/DOC-006_Information_Security_Policy.pdf",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "text-00008",
        "text-00009"
      ],
      "section_path": [
        "4. Email restriction"
      ],
      "page_numbers": [
        1
      ],
      "slide_numbers": [],
      "sheet_names": [],
      "text": "4. Email restriction\n\nOrdinary email transmission to an external recipient is not an approved mechanism for confidential customer information unless the enterprise has explicitly approved the technical protection and process for that use case. A legacy operational instruction permitting routine email transmission does not override this policy."
    },
    {
      "citation_id": "E41",
      "document_id": "DOC-006",
      "chunk_id": "DOC-006::chunk-00006",
      "source_path": "data/source/corporate_repository/policies/DOC-006_Information_Security_Policy.pdf",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "text-00010",
        "text-00011"
      ],
      "section_path": [
        "5. AI processing environments"
      ],
      "page_numbers": [
        1
      ],
      "slide_numbers": [],
      "sheet_names": [],
      "text": "5. AI processing environments\n\nConfidential information must not be entered into an AI tool unless that tool and use case are approved for the relevant information classification. Required controls include approved access, data handling terms, identity and access management, logging where applicable, and compliance with AI governance requirements."
    },
    {
      "citation_id": "E42",
      "document_id": "DOC-006",
      "chunk_id": "DOC-006::chunk-00007",
      "source_path": "data/source/corporate_repository/policies/DOC-006_Information_Security_Policy.pdf",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "text-00012",
        "text-00013"
      ],
      "section_path": [
        "6. Security incidents"
      ],
      "page_numbers": [
        1
      ],
      "slide_numbers": [],
      "sheet_names": [],
      "text": "6. Security incidents\n\nAccidental disclosure, unauthorized transmission, or suspected exposure of confidential information must be reported and handled under the active Security Incident SOP. Employees must not attempt to conceal or independently resolve a material disclosure without reporting it."
    },
    {
      "citation_id": "E43",
      "document_id": "DOC-006",
      "chunk_id": "DOC-006::chunk-00008",
      "source_path": "data/source/corporate_repository/policies/DOC-006_Information_Security_Policy.pdf",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "text-00014",
        "text-00015"
      ],
      "section_path": [
        "7. Policy precedence"
      ],
      "page_numbers": [
        1
      ],
      "slide_numbers": [],
      "sheet_names": [],
      "text": "7. Policy precedence\n\nWhere an SOP, work instruction, local guide, or historical document conflicts with this policy, the conflict must be resolved according to the Document Governance Policy. Lower-authority documents cannot weaken corporate security requirements."
    },
